description:
Leader of Hedonia, a sizable criminal gang.
Compared with other members of the Underworld Queen, she is far more pugnacious and firmly believes that violence is the ultimate panacea.
She does, however, take exceedingly good care of those who are part of her gang.

costumes.name: Ms. Dangerous
costumes.description:
Rosanna costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: If words fail, then your only recourse is physical force. That's the kind of world I operate in.
This is what happens to those who betray me.
Only those with a strong will are capable of overseeing this organization.

Come here, Mister.
If you want to stay alive, stick close to me.
Perhaps tonight, I'll make you an offer you can't refuse.
No one can touch you, except me.
Hey, if you called me out here for nothing, the least you could do is dance for me.
You're staring at me so intently. Don't think I don't know why. Well, what are you waiting for? Do you want me to make the first move?

I'll never see the inside of a courtroom.
My enforcers would take everyone out before anything went to trial.
So, all of these Nikkes are your family? Does that, perhaps... include me?
This place has a fairly thriving business district. If you want, I can offer to protect some of the establishments. How about it?

I am Rosanna, the leader of Hedonia. 
There is nothing to be afraid of, so long as you are not my enemy.
Hahaha. Now I can kill more easily.
Hmm... I assume you want me to use this power to protect you?
Now I'll be able to boost my power.
It's always wise to accept a gift from someone so good-looking.
I presume in exchange for this, you want personal protection? Very well.
You're not leading me on, are you?
Do you have your sights set on becoming more "intimately" connected with my business?
You're coming awfully close. Well, what's your next move?
From now on, any enemy of yours is an enemy of Hedonia.
It's only natural that you would need my help in times like this.
What do you need me to do?
I'm coming. Don't rush me.
Time to do what I do best.
Don't forget, everyone, this is war.
If I die, I'm taking you all with me.
Wipe them all out. Show them no mercy.
Now then, who's next?
This is child's play.
Don't worry, everyone will get their turn to die.
Let's go, guys.
Let's have some fun!
Let's see who racks up more kills!
Is that all you've got?
Bullseye.
Easy.
Ha.
How dare you?
Ah.
Are you sure you can... take it from here?
That's why you don't want to get on my bad side.

favorite.name: Signet Ring
favorite.description:
Inheriting this ring means taking over as Hedonia's boss.
It's a bloodstained path marked by endless violence, but if you have someone you can trust with your life, perhaps it isn't such a terrible fate after all.
